name: Ine (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ine town emblem in maroon: a stylised swirl with four pointed rays, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Ine, a town in Kyoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 30 September 1955.

features.role: Ine town emblem — a stylised swirl with four pointed rays, like a stylised character
